lesson: The short position failed as the distribution structure lacked a confirmed break of market structure (BOS) on the higher timeframe, leading to a liquidity sweep rather than a trend reversal. The system incorrectly prioritized EMA resistance over the underlying order flow, which remained bullish despite the local distribution narrative.
adjustment: Require a confirmed 15m/1h structural break (BOS) below the previous swing low before entering shorts, rather than relying solely on EMA rejections.
methodology_flag: Trust EMA resistance less on POLUSDT; prioritize SMC structural breaks.
